name: Omnath, Locus of the Void
description: An elemental of voracious emptiness that consumes mana and escaped a Kor Skyclave prison.

relations.note: The Kor Empire tried to trap Omnath.
relations.quote: The Kor Empire vainly thought that they could trap the elemental in a Skyclave prison
